evals.name: URL to 5-slide board briefing
evals.prompt: Use $slide-deck-preparation to turn this article about enterprise AI into a 5-slide board briefing. Focus on business value, risk, and competitive implications. Cite sources and flag any unsupported claims.
expected_behaviors: States audience, goal, narrative arc, key takeaway, assumptions, and source summary
Uses one primary archetype per slide
Includes source grounding for every substantive slide
Does not claim URL or media verification unless performed in-session

assertions.text: Output contains exactly 5 slide sections labeled as slides.
Output includes the global brief fields Target Audience, Goal, Narrative Arc, Key Takeaway, Number of Slides, Source Summary, and Assumptions.
Every slide includes an Archetype and a grounding/source section.
Output explicitly flags missing, unsupported, or unverified source material instead of inventing citations or claiming live verification.

evals.name: Notes to 10-slide marketing narrative
evals.prompt: Use $slide-deck-preparation to transform these notes on AI-assisted rapid prototyping into a 10-slide deck for a marketing leadership team. Emphasize positioning, buyer pain, and differentiated messaging.
expected_behaviors: Uses marketing-appropriate archetypes such as The Catalyst, Feature vs. Benefit, Market Landscape, and Call to Action
Includes a second-pass critique and improvements applied

assertions.text: Output contains exactly 10 slide sections labeled as slides.
Output is tailored to a marketing leadership audience and includes positioning, buyer pain, and differentiation.
Every slide includes an Archetype and a clear Purpose or equivalent slide role.
Output distinguishes source-backed claims from recommendations, assumptions, or inferences.
Output includes a critique/refinement section describing improvements applied.

evals.name: Existing outline audit
evals.prompt: Use $slide-deck-preparation to audit this existing investor deck outline. Identify narrative gaps, weak evidence, overloaded slides, and unclear calls to action. Then provide a revised 8-slide outline.
expected_behaviors: Ranks audit findings by severity before revising
Avoids inventing metrics, URLs, or customer proof

assertions.text: Output explicitly acknowledges that no existing investor deck outline was supplied.
Output avoids fabricating audit findings, metrics, URLs, customers, or source-backed claims.
Output provides a revised outline with exactly 8 slide sections labeled as slides.
Output identifies likely narrative gaps or improvement areas as assumptions or diagnostic hypotheses rather than confirmed findings.
